cut: Coxon 5, v2 (owner, 18 Oct: 'messaging too unclear') — one question, three answers
argument: Asked if it would accept responsibility for a death its AI caused, SpaceXAI came only under subpoena, by video, and answered with the law and 'everybody is in charge' — so nobody is.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: NYC asked Musk's SpaceXAI: / if your AI causes a death, / will you accept [responsibility]?
text.fi: NYC kysyi Muskin SpaceXAI:lta: / jos tekoälynne / aiheuttaa kuoleman, / kannatteko [vastuun]?
text.ja: NY市議会は SpaceXAIに 問うた。 / AIが 死亡事故を 起こしたら、 / [責任を] 負うのか？

captions.source: Asked whether the company would accept responsibility if its AI caused injury, physical damage or death (amNY; Fox live), at the Committee on Technology hearing, City Hall, 16 Oct 2026. 'Musk's SpaceX, the AI side' is the research file's safe form (§8); the council and amNY write SpaceXAI.

text.en: It took a subpoena / to get it to City Hall. / It came by [video].
text.fi: Kaupungintalolle se saatiin / vasta haasteella. / Se tuli [videolla].
text.ja: 市庁舎に 呼ぶには / 召喚状が 必要だった。 / 来たのは [ビデオ] 越し。

captions.source: Subpoenaed 28 Sept 2026; agreed on 13 Oct to testify after talks about enforcement by a state judge (council 2026/10/13/3295; CNBC 13 Oct). Appeared by video: CNBC ('appeared by video'), EFE ('por videoconferencia'), NY Daily News ('testified virtually'). The monitor in the chair is staging: no outlet says what stood at the table.

text.en: Its answer? / "We're responsible for / following the [law]."
text.ja: 答えは？ / 「我々には [法律を] / 守る 責任が ある」

captions.source: The answer to that question: "We're responsible for following the law." amNY and Fox live agree.

text.en: How many staff work on safety? / "[Everybody] is in charge / of safety."
text.ja: 安全担当は 何人？ / 「[全員が] 安全の 責任者」

captions.source: Asked how many staff work on AI safety: "everybody is in charge of safety" (NY Daily News, La Voce di New York). She later agreed to get the council a number (NYDN, amNY). The company's side, on the screen in shot 2: safety is "core" (amNY, council).

text.en: Everybody is in charge. / So [nobody] is.
text.ja: 全員が 責任者。 / つまり [誰も] 責任を 取らない。

captions.source: The station's line, over its own image: the SAFETY hat lands on the witness table and nobody picks it up.

plate.why: the company's name on its nameplate, as in Committee of the Whole

screen.why: the video tile's lower third: the company's own side, in its own word (amNY, council)

post.en: New York asked Musk's SpaceXAI: if your AI causes a death, will you accept responsibility? It took a subpoena to get it there, and it came by video. "We're responsible for following the law." Safety staff? "Everybody is in charge of safety." #AI #AIsafety #NYC
post.fi: New York kysyi Muskin SpaceXAI:lta: jos tekoälynne aiheuttaa kuoleman, kannatteko vastuun? Paikalle se saatiin vasta haasteella, ja se tuli videolla. "Olemme vastuussa lain noudattamisesta." Turvallisuushenkilöstö? "Kaikki vastaavat turvallisuudesta."
post.ja: NY市議会はマスク氏のSpaceXAIに問うた。AIが死亡事故を起こしたら、責任を負うのか？召喚状でようやく呼ばれ、来たのはビデオ越し。「我々には法律を守る責任がある」。安全担当は？「全員が安全の責任者」。
